lines.text: The east gallery. Every painting is still wet.
Ah, visitors! Admire my collection. Every clue on that canvas is genuine. Mostly.
Three of these clues are fakes. 🎭 See the count by its name.
So we trust the lines that add up. A line that's filled right but won't light up? That's a forgery.
Tap 🔍 Call out, then the clue. Right, and it hurts. Wrong, and it hurts us.
